description: Skills for L1/L2/L3 SOC analyst operations — tool-agnostic with adapter resolution

toolkit_resolution._comment: Skills reference universal intents. At runtime, the active adapter (from .secops/environment.yaml toolkit.primary_adapter) resolves each intent to a platform-specific skill file.

shared.name: incident-investigation
shared.description: Core incident investigation methodology — triage, scoping, evidence collection, timeline reconstruction, and documentation. Used by all tiers.

shared.name: rate-limiting
shared.description: API rate limiting patterns — exponential backoff, Retry-After handling, token bucket, circuit breaker. Required for all API calls across tiers.

shared.name: brute-force-detection
shared.description: Detect brute-force authentication attacks — password spraying, credential stuffing, and single-source brute force.

shared.name: compromised-account-response
shared.description: Respond to compromised accounts — revoke sessions, force password reset, assess blast radius, check persistence.

tier1_triage.name: phishing-response
tier1_triage.description: Automated phishing response — email header analysis, URL/attachment detonation, mailbox search-and-purge, user notification, IOC extraction.

tier1_triage.name: auto-triage
tier1_triage.description: Automated alert triage — severity assessment, deduplication, enrichment, and routing.

tier2_investigation.name: suspicious-signins-hunt
tier2_investigation.description: Hunt for suspicious authentication — impossible travel, brute-force, credential stuffing.

tier2_investigation.name: lateral-movement-hunt
tier2_investigation.description: Hunt for lateral movement — WMI, PSExec, RDP anomalies, pass-the-hash.

tier3_advanced.name: process-injection-detection
tier3_advanced.description: Detect process injection — DLL injection, hollowing, thread hijacking, APC injection.

tier3_advanced.name: malware-containment
tier3_advanced.description: Contain malware infection — isolate endpoint, kill processes, block C2, collect forensics.
